blocks.text:
This journey crosses several climate zones and natural landscapes. You begin with the pace of city life and the culture of Buenos Aires, followed by the tropical surroundings of Iguazu. The route then heads northwest to vineyards, high-altitude valleys and the multicoloured slopes of the Andes. The second half of the journey explores Patagonia: the lakes of Bariloche, glaciers, mountain trails, steppe and the landscapes of Tierra del Fuego.

## Highlights of the journey

Discover Argentina through its contrasts: the European architecture of Buenos Aires gives way to the tropical force of Iguazu, followed by the vineyards and high-altitude landscapes of the northwest, the lakes of Patagonia and the glaciers of the south. In Mendoza, you explore Argentine wine; in Bariloche, lakes and forests; in El Calafate, the Perito Moreno Glacier; and in Ushuaia, the rugged landscapes of Tierra del Fuego.

Some days take you into neighbouring countries and border regions. A trip to Montevideo is planned from Buenos Aires; at Iguazu Falls, you visit both the Brazilian and Argentine sides; and from Patagonia, the route takes you to Torres del Paine in Chile.

## Prices and accommodation for 2027

13,707 USD per person, based on two travellers. The rate includes services and hotels with breakfast (BB). International and domestic flights are paid for separately. The final price is confirmed when you book.

| Foz do Iguaçu | Viale Cataratas Hotel — 2 nights |

| Salta, second stay | Hotel Legado Mítico Salta — 1 night |
| Mendoza | NH Mendoza Cordillera — 3 nights |
| Bariloche | NH Edelweiss Bariloche — 3 nights |

| El Chaltén | Los Cerros del Chalten Boutique Hotel — 2 nights |
| El Calafate, second stay | Mirador del Lago Hotel — 2 nights |

The day-by-day itinerary allows 3 nights in Iguazu and 1 night in Cafayate, while the rate table lists 2 nights in each. The total duration is the same: 26 days / 25 nights. The allocation of nights on this part of the route needs to be confirmed when you book.
